name: Create Geometry Exit Ticket Flipchart
description:
Create a 5-page formative assessment 'Exit Ticket' flipchart for a 4th grade geometry lesson on angles.

Your task is to create a new flipchart with the following structure:

1. **Page 1 (Title)**: Add title text "Geometry Exit Ticket: Types of Angles" and the teacher's name "Ms. Rivera".

2. **Page 2 (Acute Angle)**: Draw an acute angle (less than 90 degrees) using the Line tool. Add the text label "Acute".

3. **Page 3 (Right Angle)**: Draw a right angle (90 degrees) using the Line tool. Add the text label "Right".

4. **Page 4 (Obtuse Angle)**: Draw an obtuse angle (greater than 90 degrees) using the Line tool. Add the text label "Obtuse".

5. **Page 5 (Self-Assessment)**: Add title text "How did you do?". Draw 3 circles (using the Shape/Ellipse tool) representing confidence levels (e.g., green, yellow, red), and label them (e.g., "Got it", "Almost", "Help").

Save the completed flipchart to: `/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/geometry_exit_ticket.flipchart`
